children: Credenza Discloses 5.4% Stake in GameSquare Holdings, Inc.

Credenza, Inc. disclosed that it acquired 979,095 shares of GameSquare Holdings, Inc., equal to a 5.4% stake. Credenza received the shares at the October 26, 2026 closing of a transaction in which GameSquare issued stock to FanEngine's sellers after FanEngine contributed substantially all its assets to a GameSquare subsidiary. The deal gave Credenza an ownership position through an asset contribution rather than a cash stock purchase, but no right to nominate a GameSquare director.

Credenza says it holds the shares for investment purposes. Its CEO, Sanzib Khaund, also serves as GameSquare's chief technology officer and may take part in management discussions and decisions. Credenza reports no current plans to seek changes at GameSquare and has no right to nominate a director.
The deal also makes Credenza eligible for 18% of any share earnout if revenue meets specified milestones. Credenza does not count those contingent shares as current ownership.

Credenza, Inc. is a Delaware corporation whose stated business focuses on digital identity, blockchain and Web3 commerce technology. Its CEO, Sanzib (Sandy) Khaund, also serves as GameSquare's chief technology officer, and Jeff Mirman serves as Credenza's chief strategy officer. Credenza received its GameSquare shares through an asset-contribution transaction, not a cash purchase.
